overrideJustification: VAL-FOUND-009 moved from foundation to reliability milestone. Previous failure was false positive: Vite embeds env vars at build time from .env, so runtime DSN override at dev server start doesn't affect cached/built code. The Sentry.init() guard in entry.client.tsx is correct. Will re-validate in reliability-verify with proper build-time override.
